api/account:
GET /account

Returns the signed-in customer's account record as JSON.

Response fields

  • id — an opaque account id (string).
  • owner — the account holder's name (string).
  • balance — the account balance as an integer number of minor units (cents). For example 10000 means $100.00. It is a number, never a string. The dashboard divides it by 100 to display a major-unit amount.
  • currency — the ISO 4217 currency code (string).

All four fields are required.
guide/contract:
The contract

The Storefront API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document (openapi.json). Every response must match the schema declared for its path and status. A field whose runtime type differs from the declared type — a number sent as a string, say — is a contract violation even when a forgiving client happens to render it correctly.
guide/money:
Money and types

Every monetary amount in this API is an integer in minor units (cents): a balance of one hundred dollars is the number 10000, not the string "10000" and not 100.0. Sending money as a string is the classic source of silent rounding and parsing bugs in downstream consumers, so the contract pins it to an integer.
